accommodation.name: Onefam Home
accommodation.neighborhood: New Town (Nové Město), near Náměstí Republiky

paymentStatus.note: Fully paid (CZK 2,440.00 total incl. city tax and VAT). Added to GASTOS.md.

accommodation.notes: 8 Bed Shared Dorm (Non-Refundable), 1 guest, 2 nights (30 Oct - 1 Nov 2026). Check-in 15:00, check-out 11:00. Age restriction 18-40. City tax not included, 50 CZK/person/night (matches the CZK 100 line item for 2 nights). Cancellations only accepted by email, at least 2 full days before arrival for standard rate (this booking is non-refundable so no free cancellation applies).

arrival.notes: ✅ CONFIRMED - Railjet RJ 171, departs Berlin Hbf 07:28, arrives Praha hl.n. 11:25 (~4h, via Dresden/Bad Schandau/Ústí nad Labem). Price 39.99 EUR, booked via Omio. Non-refundable, seat-bound. From Praha hl.n. to Onefam Home (Hybernská 1008): short walk (~10 min) or tram. Check-in at Onefam Home from 15:00, so there's a gap after arrival - consider luggage storage at the station or an early bag-drop request.

departure.notes: ✅ CONFIRMED - Sparschiene Komfort, 2nd class, EUR 23.00. Departs Praha hl.n. 10:08 on EC 115, arrives Pardubice hl.n. 11:09, change to RJ 251 (departs 11:36), arrives Wien Hbf (Bahnsteige 3-12) 14:49. Total journey ~4h41m, 27-min layover at Pardubice. Seat reservations: EC 115 Wagen 346 window seat 95 (Abteilwagen); RJ 251 Wagen 256 window seat 115 (Grossraumwagen). ⚠️ Departs BEFORE the 11:00 Onefam Home checkout deadline - pack the night before and check out early (~09:15-09:30) to make this train comfortably.

days.title: Arrival Day, City Center Free Walk & Klementinum

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Arrival from Berlin via RJ 171 at Praha hl.n. (11:25). Head to Onefam Home (Hybernská 1008) to drop off bags before check-in time (15:00), or explore the nearby Old Town.

activities.name: Arrival & Bag Drop at Onefam Home
activities.notes: Drop bags at hostel. Check-in is officially at 15:00.

timeBlocks.name: evening
timeBlocks.description: Check-in at Onefam Home, then free walk through the city center, Klementinum guided tour, Old Town Square and surroundings.

activities.name: Free Walk through Prague City Center
activities.notes: Casual stroll through the historic heart of Prague, taking in the gothic and baroque architecture.

activities.name: Klementinum - Guided Tour
activities.timeRestriction: Guided tour required - book in advance
activities.notes: Famous Baroque library, astronomical tower, and Meridian hall. Must book guide in advance.

activities.name: Old Town Square & Surroundings (Staroměstské náměstí)
activities.notes: Astronomical Clock (Orloj), Church of Our Lady before Týn, and vibrant square atmosphere.

research_notes.notes: Day 1 focused on hostel check-in, city center walk, Klementinum tour, and Old Town Square.

days.title: Farmers Market, Charles Bridge, Lennon Wall, Prague Castle & Free Roaming

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: Farmers market along the river, Charles Bridge, and Malá Strana.

activities.name: Náplavka Farmers' Market (Farmářské tržiště Náplavka)
activities.notes: Vibrant Saturday farmers market along the Vltava river embankment. Great local snacks, coffee, pastries, and atmosphere.

activities.name: Charles Bridge (Karlův most)
activities.notes: Historic Gothic bridge lined with Baroque statues, street musicians, and artists.

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Lennon Wall, Prague Castle, lunch at Café Šternberk, and historic areas.

activities.name: Lennon Wall (Lennonova zeď)
activities.notes: John Lennon-inspired graffiti wall filled with Beatles lyrics and peace art in Malá Strana.

activities.name: Prague Castle (Pražský hrad) & St. Vitus Cathedral
activities.notes: Massive ancient castle complex, St. Vitus Cathedral, Golden Lane. Exterior grounds free; interior tickets optional.

activities.name: Lunch at Café Šternberk - Mezi řádky
activities.notes: Cozy cafe located right near Prague Castle (Šternberg Palace) for coffee, pastries, or a light lunch break.

timeBlocks.name: evening
timeBlocks.description: Free roaming cycling/park time and hostel social night.

activities.name: Free Roaming: Cycling or Park Time (Letná Park / Vltava Trail)
activities.notes: Free roaming, cycling along the Vltava river trail or relaxing in Letná Park with panoramic city views at night.

activities.name: Hostel Night Plan / Social Event at Onefam Home
activities.notes: Join Onefam Home's nightly hostel activity or social event.

research_notes.notes: Day 2 includes Náplavka Farmers Market, Charles Bridge, Lennon Wall, Prague Castle, dinner, evening park/cycling, and hostel social night.

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: Early check out from Onefam Home (before the 11:00 deadline) to catch the 10:08 train, travel to Praha hl.n.

activities.name: Check Out & Transport to Praha hl.n.
activities.notes: Onefam Home is ~10 min walk or short tram/metro ride from Praha hl.n. Pack the night before since the train departs before the normal 11:00 checkout deadline.

activities.name: EC 115 to Pardubice hl.n., then RJ 251 to Wien Hbf
activities.notes: ✅ CONFIRMED - EC 115 Praha hl.n. → Pardubice hl.n. (10:08-11:09, Wagen 346, window seat 95), 27-min layover, then RJ 251 Pardubice → Wien Hbf (11:36-14:49, Wagen 256, window seat 115). Total ~4h41m. Booking ref 0661 4954 1113 4079. Bring photo ID.

research_notes.notes: Prague → Vienna transport confirmed (EC 115 + RJ 251 via Pardubice, booking 0661 4954 1113 4079).

must_try_dishes.description: Tender beef tenderloin served in a rich, sweet and savory root vegetable cream sauce with cranberries and bread dumplings.
Rich, slow-cooked beef stew seasoned with onions and paprika, served with bread dumplings (knedlíky).

drinks_and_rituals.description: World-renowned crisp Czech lager, often cheaper than water in Prague pubs.

restaurants.name: Café Šternberk - Mezi řádky
restaurants.notes: Cozy cafe located right near the Prague Castle area (Šternberg Palace), perfect for a coffee or lunch break.

restaurants.name: Restaurant St. Martin
restaurants.notes: Charming restaurant serving authentic Czech cuisine in a historic setting.

average_food_budget_reference.note: Rough daily food budget guide for Prague (per person)
average_food_budget_reference.snacks_and_drinks: 2-5 EUR (Czech beer is famously cheap, often cheaper than water)
average_food_budget_reference.daily_total_estimate: ~25-45 EUR/day eating casually/mid-range - Prague is one of the more affordable cities on this trip

practical_tips: Age restriction 18-40 at Onefam Home Prague - bring photo ID at check-in.
City tax (50 CZK/person/night) and the full non-refundable balance (CZK 2,440.00) are payable at the property - confirm whether it will be pre-charged to the card before arrival.
